name: Coherent Multiresolution Isosurface Ray Tracing
aliases: Multiresolution Isosurface Ray Tracing with Ray Packets
Multiresolution isosurface ray tracing using ray packets
Packet Ray Tracing with Octree LOD
definition: A method for interactive isosurface ray tracing of large octree volumes on commodity CPUs by grouping neighboring rays into packets to exploit spatial coherence, combined with a multiresolution level-of-detail (LOD) scheme to maintain coherence on complex data.
summary: Coherent Multiresolution Isosurface Ray Tracing optimizes interactive isosurface extraction from large volumetric octrees by grouping rays into packets and leveraging hierarchical level-of-detail to maintain coherence and enable interactive performance on commodity CPUs.
